arguments.text: Good start. Settle now, long smooth strokes, ease to race pace.

10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Goal: even effort near critical power (CP) so the reserve empties only at the finish; slightly more effort on legs against the current. Start was hot (shaft 244 W vs CP 161 W): ease to ~CP. Check CP (test was 3+12 min, can be 10-25% off) by heart-rate drift at steady effort. Watch the share of pod power reaching the boat (boat W / shaft W) for weed or pod drift. Final push from ~1.5 km to go if reserve allows, sprint last 400 m.
